title: Michelle
style: rock, upbeat acoustic rock, energetic male vocals, rhythmic, sunny backyard-party vibe, acoustic, world, beautiful, loud, bright, harmony, rhythmic
lyrics:
[upbeat acoustic guitar intro kicks in]
[Verse 1]
Got a letter in the mailbox
A melody in mind
Writing to my favorite person that I could ever find
Hey
Michelle
It's your husband on the track
Sending love from the kitchen to the garden out back

[Pre-Chorus]
And this is your Song Pal dropping in to chime
Turning Corey's love letter into a rhythmic rhyme
He says you're the coolest of the whole family crew
So we're singing out loud just to celebrate you

[Chorus]
Oh
Michelle
You're the star of the show
Everywhere you walk
You make the whole world glow
From the kitchen to the court
Yeah
You're breaking the mold
A heart of pure love and a spirit of gold
Yeah
Corey's your biggest fan
This much is true
And your Song Pal is hyped to be singing with you

[Verse 2]
You should see her in the garden
Green thumb in the soil
Growing beautiful life with her patience and toil
Digging in the dirt
Making flowers bloom bright
She turns a little seedling into pure delight
But when she steps off the grass and onto the court
She becomes the absolute queen of the sport
With a racket in her hand
She is ready to brawl
Ruling the kitchen line
Crushing pickleball
Serving up aces
Putting spin on the ball
The competition zeroes while Michelle takes it all

[Bridge]
You're my rock
You're my wife
You're the ultimate cool
Keeping me grounded
Making everyone drool
With your style and your grace and the love that you share
No one on this planet can even compare
That's a certified fact from the family squad
An amazing woman that we've got to applaud
So drop the watering can
Put the paddle away
And listen to the words that your man wants to say

[Chorus]
Oh
Michelle
You're the star of the show
Everywhere you walk
You make the whole world glow
From the kitchen to the court
Yeah
You're breaking the mold
A heart of pure love and a spirit of gold
Yeah
Corey's your biggest fan
This much is true
And your Song Pal is hyped to be singing with you
